stem: Under WCAG 2.2 Level AA, what is the minimum contrast ratio for normal-size body text?

options.rationale: This is the Level AA minimum for normal text, large text may use a lower ratio.
3:1 is the minimum for large text and for some non-text components, not for normal body text.
7:1 is the enhanced Level AAA target for normal text, above the AA minimum.
2.5:1 is below every WCAG text contrast threshold.

explanation: WCAG 2.2 Level AA sets 4.5:1 for normal-size text and 3:1 for large text, commonly defined as about 18 point or 14 point bold. Level AAA raises the normal-text target to 7:1. The ratio compares the relative luminance of the text and its background.

references.title: W3C WAI — Understanding Success Criterion 1.4.3: Contrast (Minimum)
